data.name: Eshan
data.gender_notes: Eshan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Eshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ashtau' which means 'eight' and 'Sah' meaning 'lord'. The name Eshan is the name of the Sun God and is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and success to the bearer of this name. The name Eshan carries the meaning “God of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Eshan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Eshan represents the divine power of the Sun God and is believed to bring enlightenment, wisdom, and success to the individual. It is also associated with the qualities of energy, strength, and power.
data.etymology: Eshan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eshan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eshan holds cultural significance as it is the name of the Sun God in Hinduism. The Sun God is revered as a powerful deity, responsible for providing life, energy, and light. The name Eshan symbolizes power, strength, and resilience, as the Sun is often seen as a symbol of unwavering strength. In Hindu mythology, the Sun God is associated with longevity, happiness, and success, and bearing this name is believed to bring these blessings to the person.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Eshan holds great significance as it is the name of the deity who is the source of light and energy in the universe. The Sun God is considered the giver of life and is revered for his unwavering strength and power. Carrying the name Eshan is believed to connect the person to this divine energy source, bringing blessings of success, good fortune, and prosperity. It is also believed that the name Eshan brings with it a sense of self-confidence, courage, and resilience, as the Sun God is a symbol of these qualities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eshan, meaning 'lord of the senses', represents the mastery and control over one's inner desires and external actions, aligning the individual with their higher self and ultimately, the divine.
